boundary: No utterance, transcript, reference, gold or model output text is printed or persisted: the receipt holds counts, rates, ids and hashes; synthetic note text is held in memory for the counts and dropped.

completion_side_bound.note: the digit-dense worst case fills every reading with four 12-character numerals (one token per digit or separator on this vocabulary); a note that obeys the v2 form cannot exceed the cap, so any length-truncated contact under v2 is a NON-compliant note by construction, which the dry run's R3 counts
completion_side_bound.ratio_bound_derivation: 5 lines x 20 words x 2.7162 tokens per whitespace word (the MAXIMUM observed over every sealed Perception note of this carrier)

prompt_side_delta_per_flight.note: one Perception contact per window (role_max_iterations 1); the instruction is sent once, as the last text part of that contact's user turn

tokenizer.mode: vocab-only local process: no server, no port, no GPU
